title: Stabilize the slow macOS Node 18 CI cell without weakening tests
acceptance: Only the macOS Node 18.20.3 matrix cell runs the test suite with concurrency 1; all other supported cells retain concurrency 2.
The exact PR and final main commits pass all 12 Linux, macOS, and Windows runtime cells.
The change is limited to CI and regression-test policy, keeps package 0.13.5 and the runtime build fingerprint unchanged, and does not mask functional failures.
The final official installation matches origin/main and the original dirty TravelOps worktree remains unchanged.
